title: The Heirloom Silver Thimble
scene: At 11:40 AM, the heirloom silver thimble vanished from the display cushion. Only the archivist saw the loose coral button left behind.

suspects.name: Petra Lindqvist
suspects.testimony: I sketched lace collars by the window from 11:20 to 11:45 AM—I didn't drop any loose coral button!
suspects.contradiction: Nobody had mentioned a loose coral button, and the silver thimble was tucked in Petra's glove.

suspects.name: Mabel Thornton
suspects.testimony: I brewed chamomile tea in the pantry from 11:20 to 11:40 AM before checking the display cushion.
suspects.alibiProof: Two guild members drank tea with Mabel in the pantry from 11:20 to 11:40 AM.

suspects.name: Jude Morales
suspects.testimony: I wound linen bobbins right beside the display cushion from 11:25 to 11:45 AM.
suspects.alibiProof: A visiting student watched Jude winding bobbins beside the cushion from 11:25 to 11:45 AM.

suspects.name: Arjun Mehta
suspects.testimony: I cataloged pattern books in the reading room from 11:20 to 11:45 AM and never entered the hall.
suspects.alibiProof: The reading room webcam shows Arjun cataloging books continuously from 11:20 to 11:45 AM.
